content.short: Exodus is a self custody multi-chain wallet for desktop, mobile, and browser with built-in swaps, staking, and a spending card.
content.description: Exodus is a self custody cryptocurrency wallet available on desktop, mobile, and as a browser extension, founded in 2015 and now publicly listed on the NYSE. It supports well over a million assets across dozens of networks behind a deliberately simple interface, and keeps keys on the user's device, never with the company. Built-in swaps, staking, and portfolio tracking remove the need to visit separate applications, while pairing with Trezor and Ledger hardware devices lets larger balances sit behind an offline signer.
content.meta: Exodus is a self custody multi-chain wallet with built-in swaps, staking, and hardware wallet support. Discover Exodus on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
